<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the target molecule, corresponds to a Friedel‑Crafts acylation where a halide (Cl) is removed and a new C–C bond to an acyl group is formed. We'll search the template catalog for reactions that break a halide and form a carbonyl (acyl) group, forming a C–C bond. This should give us the appropriate template ID and then we can retrieve its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CCl)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["acyl"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
